sources.title: Panini: Continual Learning in Token Space via Structured Memory
sources.snippet: We propose a human-like non-parametric continual learning framework, where the base model remains fixed, and learning occurs by integrating each new experience into an external semantic memory state that accumulates and consolidates itself continually.
